category_title: Students who strategically refuse special education services to avoid stigma
minimal_context: The student is working on a challenging classwork assignment in a general education classroom where special education accommodations are available.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Here is the new reading assignment and the worksheet. You can take this to the learning center to use your accommodations if you want.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: No, I'm just going to stay here and do it at my desk.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: This is a pretty difficult assignment. Are you sure you don't want to go?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't want to go. I just try not to use too much of my accommodations because I want to prove to my teachers that I'm better.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It's on your plan, so you should probably just use it to get the extra help.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Yeah it makes you feel embarrassed because, I just don't want people... I want to prove that I'm not just, you know, taking advantage of the system. Unless the class is too challenging, I'm not using it. I'm staying right here.
